summary: Inventory variables store values like address, FQDN, OS and SSH user for individual hosts or whole groups so you don't pass them on the command line.
questions: How do I set the SSH user for a host in inventory?
Can I set a variable for a whole group of hosts?

answer_card.title: Inventory variables
answer_card.answer_md: Set values such as IP, FQDN, OS or SSH user in the inventory so you don't pass them on every command. Variables can be defined per host or for every host in a group. Use Ansible Vault to encrypt sensitive values like passwords and keys.
